quote_zh: (1)制备得到的2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸钠盐(98.2％，0.1mol)分八次加入反应瓶中，总加料时间为2h，加毕保温反应5h。
arithmetic_check: Stated input: sodium benzoate salt 0.1 mol at 98.2 percent content, so 0.0982 mol of contained salt; no mass is printed for it, so there is no mass/mole pair to test and molar_mass_inconsistent cannot arise for the charge. Sodium alkoxide: no amount printed at all, so it cannot be tested either. Stated output: 33.4 g of product at 95.5 percent by quantitative liquid chromatography, which is 31.90 g of 2-chloro-3-{[(RS)-tetrahydrofuran-2-yl]methoxymethyl}-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid, C14H17ClO6S, molecular weight 348.80, hence 0.0915 mol. Theoretical maximum from 0.0982 mol of contained salt is 34.25 g of pure acid, and the printed 31.90 g of contained product is below it, so the mass does not exceed what the input moles could give and mass_balance_implausible does not apply. Closure against the stated yield: 0.0915 / 0.1000 = 91.5 percent, against the printed two step yield of 91.5 percent, exact agreement. THE ARITHMETIC CLOSES. One observation, recorded and not flagged: the printed yield closes against the nominal 0.1 mol and not against the content corrected 0.0982 mol, which would give 93.2 percent, so the patent's own two step yield does not carry the 98.2 percent content into its basis; and the basis it names is the methyl ester, whose charge is never printed in this example, so the yield can only be tested on the assumption that the step (1) ester cleavage was quantitative on a 0.1 mol basis. No arithmetic flag is raised on this step.
drawing_evidence: The IMAGE_EXTRACT reaction scheme at line 582, step_id 1, is this step. Its reactant is CS(=O)(=O)c1ccc(C(=O)[O-])c(Cl)c1CBr.[Na+], C9H7BrClNaO4S, the sodium salt, matching the prose, which also says sodium; its conditions are the sodium alkoxide, drawn as a structure with only the letters ONa lettered in, and HCl, both of which the prose also has, with the same sodium counter ion; its product is CS(=O)(=O)c1ccc(C(=O)O)c(Cl)c1COCC1CCCO1, C14H17ClO6S, which is the free acid the prose names as the target compound. Drawing and prose therefore agree on the counter ion and on the acidification, so no drawing_text_conflict is raised, and this example is not one of those where the patent's schemes and prose disagree about the alkali metal. The scheme draws no solvent, no charge, no temperature and no time, and it draws the acidification on the same arrow as the substitution, whereas the prose separates them by a solvent strip, which is why the record keeps the acid in the workup and is_one_pot false.
